html:
Dr. Ginger Henson was a perfect choice for me! She did an excellent job. I had no pain and healed up better than ever! I'm so happy with the job she did for me!

Lynne S.

My initial appointment with Dr. Pargament was in April 2022. He seemed very concerned that my eyelids hung so low overall my eye and my left eyelid was swollen. He explained to me that they would take tissue from my eyelid and stitch it together. I was impressed with Dr. Pargament because of his concern and the way he explained to me how the surgery would enhance my vision.

Patricia B.

Dr. Henson did a great job with my eye surgery. She is friendly, professional and explains everything up front. I would definitely recommend her.

Sara G.

Dr. Henson was wonderful. She took the time to listen, answer my questions and treated me well... thank you☺️☺️☺️☺️

Sheila K.

Dr. Pargament performed a brow lift on me because my brows were falling and affecting my eye sight. I had this done in March, 2024. In August, 2024 he performed an eyelid lift because my eyelids were falling and affecting my vision. My vision has improved greatly. Dr. Pargament is easy to talk to and very personable and professional. I would highly recommend him for either one of these surgeries. He's the best!!

Barbara B.

I had eyelid surgery two weeks ago and I am extremely happy with the results. Dr. Pargament explained clearly what the problems were and what the surgery would involve. He is very knowledgeable and answered all my questions patiently. Every person I spoke with throughout the process was courteous and helpful. I would highly recommend him. Karen Goodwin

L D G.

Second time seeing Dr. Henson explained what her goal was for me, and we set it into motion, glad Dr. Henson is in my corner.

Robert G.

I made an appointment to see Dr. Pargament about having a hard time seeing with my eyelids being heavy. I thought he could trim my lids but he said it wouldn’t help. It was my forehead! He lifted it through wrinkles. He did a great job. I’m still amazed how bright everything is. I’m so glad I did it, I see so much more.

Penny F.

Dr. Henson was able to make a firm diagnosis of what my watery eye problem was caused by. She was very easy to follow on what my expected surgery would accomplish. While I am not looking forward to the post-op recovery which will follow the surgery, I am confident I am in good hands with Dr. Henson.

Barb D.

The shots are important to me. Things once again went smoothly. I am quite happy with the doctor and the assistants.

Donna W.

Caring, gentle, thorough, wonderful patient - Dr. experience. My surgery (pre and post) in general has been top notch. I wish I had more stars to give.

Lynne J.

My experience with Dr. Jonathan Pargament and the team was very good. They were helpful, courteous and efficient. I am pleased with the process and most importantly the outcome.

Rose H.

Dr. Henson was personable, kind and professional. She took the time to explain every detail of my surgery to me. I trust and feel comfortable having her as my surgeon. Her assistant was friendly and knowledgeable as well. I appreciate Dr. Henson has put me at ease about my surgery. Thank you.

Darlana W.

Was a good consult. Answered my questions. Will use them again when I need eye care.

Wilby T.

Dr. Henson is a thoughtful and caring Doctor and a real professional! I highly recommend her!

Brian M.

The whole process was easy! Staff was great and so was the Dr.

Carol A.

Dr. Henson and the entire staff give me the confidence that I am in the hands of people with whom I can trust for the best possible care. I feel I am treated as they would treat a family member. My questions are thoroughly answered and my concerns always addressed.

Barbara L.

From first visit through after surgery visit he explained what he was going to do. Incisions healing well and don't appear to be that noticeable.

Gerald P.

He is very intense and knowledgeable. I felt complete confidence in his qualifications. I would only suggest he talk a little slower. I intend to make a follow up appointment to go over the details again of my pending surgery.

Doree M.

I would highly recommend Dr. Henson and her staff. Everyone I dealt with was very professional and respectful. The surgery was explained to me as well as what the results would be. If I ever need more work done I would not hesitate to use Dr. Henson again.

Jack G.

Excellent work repairing my husband's cancer surgery near his eye. We appreciate also that we were late and the Doctor worked us into his busy schedule. Thank you!

Kathy C.

I really liked Dr. Jonathan Pargament and his staff 🙂

Marlayne S.

Was very comforted and impressed with the quality of services provided by Dr. Henson and her care team.

MartIn E.

Dr. Pargament and his staff are the BEST!🥰 I’ve had two eyelid surgeries. He answered all my questions, I felt very comfortable. Dr. P will call you back himself if you have additional questions or concerns. Dr. Pargament and his entire staff are who I’ll be sticking with!!🥰

Tracy S.

Dr. Henson and staff are each very professional and friendly.

Dale T.

I had a minor eye surgery but was extremely nervous about undergoing anything like that on my eyes. Dr. Pargament was AWESOME at putting me at ease during the procedure and I felt like I was in good hands. He and the staff were very professional and always helpful. I would certainly recommend him.

Kim B.-C.

This is the 1st time I saw Dr. Henson knowing that I needed eye surgery. Dr. Henson and her assistant are very professional and made me feel at ease. Explains things very well that I could understand.

Paul W.

Very good experience overall. Hardest part was sleeping sitting up.

Richard F.

Dr. Pargament is honest, straightforward and explains every detail regarding the reason for your visit and the potential procedure. I definitely walked away with much more information than I was sent there with. Whether I choose to have the procedure or not, I will never burn any bridges with Dr. Pargament or his staff. He gave me much to think about and I appreciate the time he took with me.

Judy B.

Dr. Henson is a doctor that I found great confidence in. She has taken her time with the issue I have with my eyes and not rushed the diagnosis. I am now looking forward to the surgery which is indicated and will correct my eyes. Many thanks to Dr. Henson.

Kris M.

Great bedside manner. Very thorough exam with detailed information regarding the result he found. He explained the procedures he was going to perform on me to which I understood. My 33 year old son had a great experience with Dr. Pargament also.

Trish L.

Dr. Ginger Henson is an excellent doctor. She's not only kind, friendly, professional & knowledgeable, but she truly does care about you. When she looks you in the eye, you can feel her compassion & sincerity. She listens & is supportive. When she did my procedure, I didn't feel a thing. I have total confidence & trust in Dr. Ginger Henson.

A

I visited Dr. Pargament in March 2023 for treatment of a residual sac resulting from a sty on my right eyelid. Dr. Pargament determined that removal by surgery would not be required, and he proceeded with injection of a steroid. Two weeks later, the sac is completely gone. Great service, professional staff, great outcome!

Larry R.

Dr. Ginger Henson was very personable and professional, detailed in what we should expect of the surgery my son had and the follow up care required. Her conversations with me made me very confident in her ability as a surgeon and she did an excellent job on our son’s eye. She was thorough in her follow up care, very friendly and fun with our son, which made him look forward to his visits! Overall very happy indeed with the care given.

Catherine M.

Dr. Henson is wonderful, incredibly concerned, compassionate and very patient with you. When you're talking to her, you do feel like she is actually listening to you. And that's just super cool. I have been dealing with thyroid and eye issues most of my life and I feel absolutely safe and comfortable with Dr. Henson.

Eileen S.

Dr. Pargament was knowledgeable, communicated well and had a great bedside manner. He listened to the patient/ family and answered our questions. He was efficient without making us feel rushed. I would highly recommend him 😊👍

Ruth C.

I saw Dr. Pargament to see if he could improve my vision because of having a lazy eye lid. Vision was blurry and I was very afraid of losing more of my vision. My pre-surgical visit was informative and my trust for Dr. Pargament was there from the beginning. My surgery prep and aftercare from his nursing team was amazing. The surgery was really easy and for a medical procedure it was one of the best experiences I have had to date. Recommendations from me do not come lightly, they must be earned. Dr. Pargament far exceeded my expectations and I would highly recommend him and his team.

Greg B.

Dr. Henson was a joy to be with. Very positive and reassuring. Her bedside manner had me feeling very confident in ability and trust. I would recommend her to anyone. She was not done until I was 100% satisfied. Very much a pleasure .

Pam F.

I recently had eyelid and brow surgery. I had a very professional experience and would highly recommend his expertise and his team on overall being highly respected.

Debbie D.

Dr. Henson is very upbeat and knowledgeable. I really enjoyed meeting with her and now understand my options. I will go forward with the lid surgery soon. But, have other obligations at the moment.

Gloria W.

She was friendly and knowledgeable and answered all my questions. I had a great visit.

Linda K.

The staff was very nice and helpful. Dr. Pargament did a superb job!!! he fixed the eye condition I had for years and I couldn’t ask for better results. Now I have Mo betta eyes 🙂

April F.

Dr. Henson immediately did a biopsy to determine my condition. I appreciate her taking action right away. I highly recommend her.

Teresa S.

He has been the best !! He cares, he is enthusiastic and makes you feel comfortable at all times. I would recommend a thousand times!! So far my eyes are looking great it's been 1 week.

theswagman 300

Dr. Henson did a biopsy of an area on my eyelid. On time, easy for me, done and out. I appreciate the fact that I was able to get the last minute appointment and that it went so quickly and smoothly as I had a 6 hour drive that day. Thank you.

Jan S.

Dr. Pargament was very nice and spot on with details as to what I needed. He's great!

L V.

Upon arrival, the usual hand sanitizer and self-temperature check. The reception was super nice and friendly, and checking in was a breeze. The sitting in the waiting room was appropriately spaced and they actually sanitize after each patient, something I don’t see at other clinical facilities👍. The wait was negligible and I was ushered in. Dr. Pargament was easy going and puts you at ease. He describes the procedure and other options available. The entire procedure went quickly and I was out the door with after care instructions. It was a very good experience, and I will definitely be back for follow up and other procedures as needed. Thank you Dr. Pargament.

Juliana M.

My visit went well with Dr. Henson. Very knowledgeable. Very encouraging. I’m very satisfied.

Malcolm M.

I have been going to Dr. Henson for a few years now, with treatment I receive every four months of my eyelid twitches. She takes time to discuss my well-being and asks if I have questions. Very patient and helpful. Also very timely.

Chris S.

I was very pleased with Dr. Henson's work on my inflamed stye. I really needed her help, too. Her staff also were very very professional and caring. So, I say, "God bless 'em all - every one!"🙋‍♂️😇

F M

I have been completely satisfied with the eye care I have received.

Roger S.

Dr. Pargament is a very caring provider. And very responsive to questions.

Pam L.

Very professional. No waiting time, plus very helpful with everything you needed to know. The doctor was polite and very thorough explaining everything. I would highly recommend them to everyone. The staff was also superb!

Judy H.

I was extremely pleased with the service provided by Dr. Henson and her staff. They were professional and efficient. Their instructions were very clear and precise and prepared me for the surgery and post-operative care. I would highly recommend them for your eye care.

Sue G.

Dr. Henson and her staff were very efficient. I appreciate their professional testing and treatment. I was a few minutes early to my appointment but they were right on schedule.

David S.

Consultation regarding a droopy eyelid which has been corrected twice in the past. Began with testing (by staff) to determine insurance coverage, followed by Dr. Pargament’s assessment of options, which from my previous experience were very credible.

Dean N.

My experience with Dr. Ginger Henson and her staff was rewarding. Many questions were asked first, then an eye exam. Yes, I had a problem with my right eyelid. Surgery would correct this heavy eyelid condition. I would like to know if this surgery would leave me with a rise in my right eyebrow? Would it be noticeable? Thank you, Mr. Severance

Walter S.

He listened to what I expected and I wasn’t rushed out. He was up front with me as to what I could expect. Everyone is always very friendly and helpful, I wouldn’t even think about going elsewhere.

Janice N.

Dr. Pargament is a wonderful physician. He’s a skilled eye surgeon with a great bedside manner. He helped with my treatments and was a great source of new innovative treatments, that may help with my eye problems. I highly recommend Dr. Pargament if you need eye surgery.

Vicky J.

I recently had eyelid surgery performed by Dr. Pargament. The entire process went well and I was very impressed by the Dr. and the way he put me at ease while answering all my questions. He and the entire team were very professional and everything went well with absolutely no pain. I can without a doubt recommend him to anyone needing eye surgery.

Mark I.

Kept me well-informed as to diagnoses and treatments. Answers questions and makes certain the patient has an understanding of what has happened, what is being proposed, and the goals. I highly recommend Dr. Henson.

Ken L.

The staff were phenomenal! I saw Dr. Ginger Henson and her nurse practitioner for lesions on my lid and under my eye. They did biopsies of both. 3 weeks later, you would never know they were ever there! Thank you SO much!!!

Beverly N.
